object.attr: derived: CF-E2. Undo puts the manifest back whole (MELLON-EDIT-SRS-345), next object number included, so undoing New object lets the next create give the undone object's ID again, against MELLON-EDIT-SRS-1 and MELLON-EDIT-SRS-2. Checked in the code by the lead on 2026-11-11; a defect to fix (D-E1, review Q17).
object.description: When the user undoes or redoes an undo step, Mellon shall leave the document's next object number no lower than the number before the undo or redo.
